retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s rock aesthetic featuring a central performer in dramatic stage lighting with bold, outlined slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body shot of a male rock performer in a leather jacket, holding a guitar with one fist raised, set against a dark background with a strong magenta-tinted spotlight. The layout is framed by a thick black border and features bold, outlined typography at the top and a diagonal text banner across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a raised arm creating a strong vertical axis
Diagonal text banner intersecting the subject's torso to create dynamic movement
High-contrast lighting separating the subject from a deep black background
Typography anchored to the top-left and bottom-right to balance the composition
coreInvariants: Magenta and deep red color cast in the highlights
Heavy black framing around the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body figure, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The raised fist at the top and the guitar headstock at the bottom create a vertical tension.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left title, down the raised arm to the face, then along the diagonal text banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black borders and deep shadows around the performer focus all attention on the lit central figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta/Deep Red (spotlight and primary text fill)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright spotlight and the crushed blacks; saturated magenta tones in the midtones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and classic typewriter-style serifs
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with a heavy white outline
Secondary text uses a typewriter-style slab serif with high legibility
Tight letter spacing for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title characters are compressed horizontally to feel more massive
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display slab serif paired with a lighter, more traditional slab serif for contrast in weight and angle.

preserve: Diagonal orientation of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the main title.
Captures the feel of the diagonal secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a male rock musician in a black leather jacket, holding a guitar with one arm raised in a fist. Use a dark background with a strong magenta-red spotlight hitting the subject from the side. Frame the entire image with a thick black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, uppercase slab-serif title in the top-left corner with a magenta fill and white outline. Add a lowercase slab-serif subtitle across the center of the image at a -15 degree angle in white text.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting predominantly magenta and high-contrast?
Is the main title outlined in white?
Is there a diagonal text element across the subject?
Is the subject wearing a leather jacket and holding a guitar?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the black outer frame
postGenerationChecks: Check for magenta color cast in highlights
Ensure the black border is thick and uniform
Verify the diagonal text is legible against the subject
Confirm the slab-serif font has the correct 'heavy' weight
Ensure the raised fist is a focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Rock Musician) + Lighting (Magenta Spotlight) + Frame (Black Border) + Type (Outlined Slab Serif + Diagonal Subtitle) = Retro Rock Aesthetic
